what: Hovering a photo sweeps a background-colored mist band along the diagonal from bottom left to top right over 1.7s — band width 1 (on a 0~1 diagonal), 8 layers of warp noise make the edge wavy and 4 layers of density noise mottle the thickness between .54~.99. Progress is 1−(1−p)² so it comes in fast and leaves slowly. A 180×120 cell canvas is stretched when drawn, so it looks smooth.

options.[data-fx-part=media]: (Optional) photo slot to cover with fog — if none, the element itself

note: Replays from the start on every hover. Not applied on touch devices (no hover)
